query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN coverImage IS NOT NULL AND coverImage != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_images,
  SUM(CASE WHEN coverImage IS NULL OR coverImage = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as without_images
FROM news;
